_doc: tools/import_frames.gd: Tide's in-match side view from the AI-made run cycle (frame_1..8.png, 1280x720, facing right, transparent) and the ready pose (poses.ready: ../side_ready/ready_v1.png, 887x1792, kneeling, fists together on the chest, no gun, green backdrop; the AI sparkle over the front boot's toe un-blended out of it before it was saved here). Source px unless noted. height: 64 world px for her 592 px run figure (0.108 world px per source px, the roster's 0.113 x 0.96: her head drawn as big as Flora's in the run frames, her legs longer; any taller and she towers over the others); no standing picture yet: idle is the run frame_2 (the passing pose, both feet down: the most upright one; anims.idle.fallback); walk 12 fps: the planted foot moves back ~7.7 world px a frame (90 px/s walk); canvas pinned (a standing picture that fits leaves the run frames' PNGs as they are). See assets/README.md.

restoreWhites._doc: the run frames were cut from the video's white backdrop by a global white key (media-edit ani.py: every px over 240 cleared, her eye whites and the white of her boots and shorts too, their colour kept under alpha 0): the enclosed holes not of the backdrop's (252, 252, 252) made opaque again; the gaps of backdrop between an arm or a leg and the body stay clear

idle._doc: the standing picture (poses.stand, ../side_idle/idle_v1.png, not drawn yet); without it the run frame_2 (index 1: the passing pose, both feet on the ground)

draw._doc: the ready pose, shown at once while the gun is out (gunDraw: no transition)

fire._doc: the shot from the ready pose: its frame with the recoil (the hugged gun kicks back along its axis by the flash)

gun._doc: angle per frame is added to the hold (+ = muzzle down). The gun is holstered in idle / walk in the match; carry: where it would be held (px from the feet pivot, source px). fists (optional, Rookie's config): the near fist per source frame, to sway the gun with the arm.

gunDraw._doc: gun_draw.gd TIMINGS overrides: the ready pose switches in and out at once

stand._doc: pose px (1280x720): standing upright, facing right, transparent background (cleaned like the run frames). Not drawn yet (anims.idle.fallback until then). scale: source px per pose px (the hair and the face as wide as in the run frames); alignX: the ear on frame_1's (the head does not jump idle <-> walk <-> ready).

ready._doc: pose px (887x1792): kneeling, facing right, both fists together in front of the chest, NO gun, the water tank on her back, on a flat green backdrop (keyed out: `background`, holeMin / holePure / spillFrom keyed). scale: source px per pose px (the face from the ear to the nose as wide as in the run frames: 117 / 319 px); alignX: the middle of the face (ear .. nose) on frame_1's, so the head does not jump on the switch. The hug gun is placed in `scene` (its GunSocket on the fists: the gun turns round it).

gun._doc: the fallback seat (no scene): the hug point, the middle of the two fists (pose px), level

armFront._doc: the near arm drawn OVER the hugged gun (assets/characters/tide/side/ready_arm_front.png, same canvas as ready_0), pose px: polygon round the near sleeve (from the shoulder), the forearm and both fists; seeds: one point inside each piece the outline walls in (the far forearm under the fists stays under the gun). See Rookie's config for the keys.
